title: Lady Goes Completely Nuts After Drug Bust
description:
An officer conducted a traffic stop and could smell the odor of marijuana emanating from the vehicle. The vehicle had 2 occupants, Daniel and Andrea. Given the situation, the officer called for backup. Watch till the end for the full details about the charges. Both Daniel and Andrea were charged with Possession of Marijuana, illegal Possession of Controlled Substances, and Possession of Drug paraphernalia. Additionally, Daniel was also charged with failure to maintain lane and no insurance.

We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
